title: Monster wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- monster body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='34' ry='30' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <!-- lighter belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#8be28b'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <polygon points='28,36 22,14 38,30' fill='#f9e05c'/>
  <polygon points='72,36 78,14 62,30' fill='#f9e05c'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='17' cy='68' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#3d9140' transform='rotate(-20 17 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='68' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#3d9140' transform='rotate(20 83 68)'/>
  <!-- sunglasses frame -->
  <rect x='22' y='48' width='24' height='15' rx='5' fill='#7b3fa0'/>
  <rect x='54' y='48' width='24' height='15' rx='5' fill='#7b3fa0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='52' width='12' height='5' fill='#7b3fa0'/>
  <!-- sunglass lenses -->
  <rect x='25' y='51' width='18' height='9' rx='3' fill='#2b1055'/>
  <rect x='57' y='51' width='18' height='9' rx='3' fill='#2b1055'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x='28' y='53' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#a06ee0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='53' width='4' height='3' rx='1' fill='#a06ee0'/>
  <!-- teeth / mouth -->
  <path d='M38 78 Q50 88 62 78 L62 82 Q50 92 38 82 Z' fill='#f0f0f0'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='91' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#3d9140'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='91' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#3d9140'/>
</svg>
